_doc: tools/import_frames.gd: Rookie's in-match side view from the AI-made run cycle (frame_1..8.png, 1280x720, facing right), the standing idle (poses.stand: ../side_idle/idle_v1.png) and the ready-to-shoot pose (poses.ready: ../side_ready/ready_v1.png, kneeling, hugging the gun). Source px unless noted. See assets/README.md.

idle._doc: the standing picture (poses.stand); without it the run frame 0 (frame_1.png)

draw._doc: the ready pose, shown at once while the gun is out (gunDraw: no transition)

fire._doc: the shot from the ready pose: its frame with the recoil (the hugged gun kicks back along its axis by the flash, scenes/character/character.gd HUG_KICK)

gun._doc: angle per frame is added to the hold (+ = muzzle down; die: the gun ends lying level with the fallen body). fists: the near (camera-side) arm's fist centre per source frame; the grip follows it by `follow` from `carry` (px from the feet pivot, source px), so the gun sways with the arm but stays carried. swingDeg: muzzle tilt at the ends of the swing (forward = up).

hand._doc: the fist drawn over the gun's grip, cut from this frame (circle, soft edge) into hand.png; not cut while the ready pose is there (Rookie holds his gun only in it, hugged by his own fists)

gunDraw._doc: gun_draw.gd TIMINGS overrides: the ready pose switches in and out at once

stand._doc: pose px (1280x720): standing upright, facing right, transparent background (cleaned like the run frames: alphaCut / keepPieces / defringe). scale: source px per pose px (the cap and the face as wide as in the run frames; 1.02 keeps the cap inside the pinned canvas); alignX: the ear on frame_1's (the head does not jump idle <-> walk <-> ready); the soles on the soles' row.

ready._doc: pose px (882x1024): kneeling, facing right, both fists together in front of the chest, NO gun, on a flat green backdrop (keyed out: `background`; the small AI sparkle bottom right goes with the detached pieces, keepPieces). scale: source px per pose px (the cap and the head as wide as in the run frames); alignX: the belt buckle on frame_1's (the standing idle's head is lined up with it too); the knee / boot on the soles' row. The hug gun is placed by hand in `scene` (its GunSocket on the fists: the gun turns round it).

gun._doc: the fallback seat (no scene): the hug point, the middle of the two fists (pose px), level

armFront._doc: the near arm drawn OVER the hugged gun (assets/characters/rookie/side/ready_arm_front.png, same canvas as ready_0; tools/import_frames.gd arm_mask()), pose px. polygon: the region the cut may take (the shoulder, the sleeve down to the elbow and along the belly, both fists); seeds: one point inside each piece the outline walls in (the upper arm, the forearm, the fists; the far arm's cuff right of the fists has none: it stays under the gun); darkMax: the brightest channel of an outline pixel; grow: the outline width kept round the cut; feather: its soft edge (px). Check after an import: ready_arm_front.png.
